# Proton-ish

> Steam Play for macOS. Proton-ish lets Windows games in the normal macOS Steam library run on an Apple Silicon Mac,
> the way Proton does on Linux. Games run through Wine, with Highball's free Wine 11 engine or with CrossOver.
> Free and open source (GPLv3).

- Requirements: an Apple Silicon Mac with macOS 15 or newer, the Steam app for macOS, and Rosetta 2.
- Install: `brew install --cask magnuspladsen/tap/proton-ish`, or download Proton-ish.zip from the latest release.
- Use: open Proton-ish, set up Steam from its Status page, then pick a Highball or CrossOver engine under a game's
  Properties → Compatibility in Steam and press Play.
- Compatibility: most games that run in Highball or CrossOver run through Steam with Proton-ish. Check a game in
  highball-db first. Kernel anti-cheat and Valve Anti-Cheat secure servers don't work.
- Not affiliated with or endorsed by Valve, Apple, CodeWeavers or Highball.
